assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture atlas, square 1024x1024 RGBA with truly transparent background. Four clean isolated botanical elements laid out in exact 2x2 equal quadrants with generous transparent gutters, each element fitting entirely inside its quadrant. TOP LEFT: one long fern frond, straight vertical midrib from bottom to top, tapering lobed leaflets, muted cool sage and teal green, stylized broad legible silhouette. TOP RIGHT: one broad rounded pointed woodland leaf, straight central vein vertical from bottom to top, slightly heart shaped base, muted sage green. BOTTOM LEFT: one different long fern frond, broader slightly asymmetric leaflets, same vertical orientation. BOTTOM RIGHT: one broad elongated oval leaf, muted teal sage green. All are flat overhead botanical surfaces, no perspective, no bent 3D plants, no pot, no roots. Neutral diffuse lighting, NO cast shadows, no white halo, no black outline, no labels, no text, no background paper, no decorative frame. This will be alpha-tested on curved geometry in a performance-conscious 3D forest, avoid tiny isolated details. Fronds/leaf bases toward bottom of EACH quadrant, tips toward top.
